description: This file is a shell script containing a series of automated tests for Git commit functionalities, including templates, signoffs, squash, and related options. It includes functions for setting up tests, executing Git commands, and verifying commit messages. The script also tests various edge cases and error conditions related to Git commit processes.

methods.name: commit_msg_is
methods.description: Verifies the latest commit message matches the expected string.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a description.

methods.name: get_commit_msg
methods.description: Retrieves the full body of a commit message given a revision.

methods.name: commit_for_rebase_autosquash_setup
methods.description: Sets up a series of commits used for testing rebase autosquash features.

methods.name: test_fixup_reword_opt
methods.description: Runs tests to verify that reword fixup options are incompatible with certain flags.

methods.name: set_fake_editor
methods.description: Simulates an editor for testing commit message editing.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new test repository for setup.
